controller.summary: Implemented the controller half of PRD_PORTABLE_WORKFLOW slice 2. New: workflow/guardrails.py (outcome-brief headings, decisions.md pinning, design challenge print job with pause/resume/--accept-challenge, worker questions with persisted deadline pause, `workflow resume` and `workflow answer`), contracts/workflow/challenge.schema.json, workflow/skills/workflow-grill/SKILL.md, workflow/test_guardrails.py (one test per controller scenario id: brief-headings, decisions-required, challenge-passes, challenge-pauses x2, completion-evidence, worker-question, export-seam, plus the skill). Changed: feature.schema.json 2.2.0 (challenge, prd); launch.py (2.2.0 refusals before Git, migration note for 2.0/2.1, prepare --guardrails flags, stops after a paused start); pipeline.py (prepare pinning, challenge gate in start, start_workers); automatic.py (completion 1.1.0 read_signal/read_completion, questions in wait_handoffs, shared print_command, decisions in reviewer prompts); interactive.py (worker_prompt with decisions); export_state.py (export 1.5.0: decisions, challenge+attempts, evidence, questions, challenge node); registry.py and scaffold.py (init writes 2.2.0 + decisions.md + prd placeholder); contracts/projects v1.ts/examples/runInputs.schema.json (inputs 1.4.0 per PRD 4.7) + contract test [scenario:export-seam]; server/projects.ts (export 1.5.0 pass-through, challenge node status) + test [scenario:served-inputs]; README/RUNBOOK/contract READMEs. Updated existing tests only where the contract changed (export version 1.4.0->1.5.0, init scaffold now 2.2.0 with decisions.md and 15 placeholders, 1.0.0 completion exports null evidence, inputs contract 1.3.0->1.4.0, unknown export version 1.5.0->1.6.0, 2.0.0 launch stderr is now exactly the migration note). Checks executed: python -m unittest workflow.test_portable workflow.test_guardrails -> 23 OK; workflow.test_guardrails.GrillSkill -> 1 OK; python -m unittest workflow.test_automatic workflow.test_interactive workflow.test_pipeline workflow.test_feature_launch workflow.test_export workflow.test_sessions -> 156 run, 1 failure (test_pipeline:266 expected export 1.4.0), fixed to 1.5.0; python -m unittest workflow.test_lanes + that pipeline test -> 22 run, 1 failure (LegacyFeatureAndRun expected empty stderr; now asserts exactly the migration note); rerun LegacyFeatureAndRun + pipeline test -> 4 OK; npm run test:contracts -> 22/22 pass; npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts -> 38/38 pass; npx tsx --test server/app.test.ts -> 3/3 pass; npm run build -> OK; npm run contracts:export regenerated runInputs.schema.json. The worktree has no node_modules: for the npm/tsx checks I symlinked /home/agentops/dev/md-manager/node_modules temporarily and removed it (and dist/) afterwards. NOT run: the full workflow suite (python -m workflow.run_tests), npm run test:unit, workflow.test_checks, workflow.test_verification, workflow.test_run_tests; nothing was run against real Claude or real Herdr.
open_assumptions: Completion 1.1.0 and every guardrail plan key apply only to runs prepared from a 2.2.0 feature (prepare --guardrails); 2.0.0/2.1.0 runs launched after slice 2 keep completion 1.0.0, so they see no guardrail refusal.
The migration note goes to stderr and the dry-run JSON key `guardrails`, not into `notes`, so existing launch output and commands stay unchanged.

The challenge runs inside `start`/`resume` outside LangGraph; the `challenge` node exists in the exported definition and registry graph only. The server derives its status from inputs.challenge (paused -> paused, passed/accepted -> succeeded), and EVENT_STATUS gains `paused`.
`resume` needs no --live (the PRD's command form); after a pass or accept it launches the workers and supervises automatic runs; --herdr attaches panes.
Feature-file edits made for `resume` leave the source checkout dirty and integration refuses a dirty source; the RUNBOOK tells the operator to stash them before integration. Nothing automates this.
The PRD is copied into <run>/challenge-inputs/ (so a PDF works) and passed with --add-dir; plan.json keeps its path and sha256. decisions.md text and task paths are pinned in plan.json.

The challenge job deadline is the run's review_timeout_seconds (1800 s for manual runs). A disabled record has attempt 0, session null, no concerns and null alternative/experiment; `attempts` equals the latest record's attempt.

Served worker-written texts (decisions, questions, answers, challenge texts, untested, verify_yourself) are path-redacted like other served text. falsifying_check is served verbatim only when it equals one of the lane's check ids or commands.
Herdr delivery uses `herdr pane send-text <pane> <text>` then `herdr pane send-keys <pane> Enter`; the key name `Enter` was not verified against real Herdr.
A worker's session going back to `working` while a question waits counts as an answer typed in the pane: it is recorded as '(answered by typing in the worker's pane)' and the deadline restarts.

A fourth question raises, which blocks the run and stops the workers like status blocked; its completion file stays in place as evidence. A question completion needs a non-empty summary like any other.
feature.json challenge/prd on a version before 2.2.0 is refused; a `prd` must be relative with no `..` (schema) and exist in the target.

ui.summary: Implemented the viewer half of slice 2 (PRD_PORTABLE_WORKFLOW 4.5-4.8). Markdown.tsx: opt-in `inert` prop (default and non-project callers unchanged): links render as text plus target, images as labelled placeholders, nothing fetched. New src/projects/Challenge.tsx: challenge page (status, concerns grouped P0/P1/P2 with consequences, simpler alternative, cheap experiment, attempts, accepted reason); NodeDetail routes the `challenge` node (kind review) to it instead of the review panel, and the review-node lookup excludes it; status.ts isChallengeNode + executor 'one print job' (graph and node page). WorkerInputs.tsx: completion evidence (untested, falsifying check linked to the verify node's check by id or command with data-check-index, verify-yourself; 'not recorded for this run' when all three are null; 'no evidence yet' for status question) and a questions list with times, answers and a 'Waiting on the operator' marker. Assignment.tsx: decisions.md rendered inert, or a sentence when absent; captured files and tasks rendered inert. Fixtures/seed: inputs projected at contract 1.4.0 (null decisions/challenge/evidence, [] questions for older runs); new workflow guarded-flow with run-guarded (1.5.0 export): challenge accepted over P1+P2 at attempt 2, ui 1.1.0 completion with falsifying_check 'project-workflows-browser' and one answered question, adapter waiting on question 2 after a blocked verification, decisions.md and a captured src/projects/GUARDRAILS.md both with a remote image and external link. New tests/project-workflows/guardrails.spec.ts with the five scenarios. CHECKS ACTUALLY RUN. In this worktree (after `npm ci`, node_modules gitignored): `npm run build` exit 2, 19 TS errors, all missing contract fields (Property 'decisions'/'challenge'/'questions'/'untested'/'falsifying_check'/'verify_yourself' does not exist; 'question' not in the completion status enum). `WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=worker|candidate npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts tests/project-workflows/guardrails.spec.ts`: both exit 1 at config load: ZodError 'Invalid input: expected "1.3.0"' in validateRunInputs (contracts/projects/v1.ts:290) called from fixtures.ts projectInputs. Until the controller's contract lands, this blocks loading the whole project-workflows suite in this worktree. Pre-integration check in a scratch copy outside the worktree ($CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/stub, identical src/ and tests/, confirmed with diff -r), with contracts/projects/v1.ts and server/projects.ts stubbed from PRD 4.7 by me, not taken from the controller: `npm run build` passed; guardrails.spec.ts 5/5 passed in the worker and candidate phases; the existing executor-marks, created-file-rendered, output-first-task-collapsed, findings-on-files, findings-by-reviewer, legacy-run and paths-redacted scenarios (filtered with -g) passed 7/7 in both phases; eslint on the changed paths was clean. With captured files switched back to non-inert, inert-markdown failed (2 <a> elements), so the test detects that regression. Not run: npm run test:unit or the whole browser suite, as instructed.
open_assumptions: The raw 1.5.0 export inputs section (what seed.ts writes and the real server reads) uses the same field names and shapes as the served payload in PRD 4.7: decisions, challenge (+attempts, no run_id/version), completion untested/falsifying_check/verify_yourself, and per-worker questions. If the controller's export spells them differently, seed.ts must follow it.

Served run inputs are pinned at contract_version 1.4.0 for every run, older ones included (with null decisions/challenge/evidence and [] questions), the same way review results are pinned at 1.4.0. So every fixture projection now uses 1.4.0.
challenge.session_id and decided_at may turn out nullable in the controller's schema; the page handles both (the scratch stub types them as non-null).

A completion counts as legacy ('evidence was not recorded for this run') exactly when untested, falsifying_check and verify_yourself are all null. A completion with status 'question' shows 'no evidence yet' instead. The seeded waiting worker is served with that question completion.

falsifying_check links when it equals a declared check id, or exactly a declared check's command. The link goes to verify_<lane> with data-check-index for the matching executed check, the same way the existing task-check links work (there is no in-page scroll to the check).

Inert mode applies to every Markdown the viewer renders from run data: captured files, decisions.md and worker tasks (the Goal says 'every Markdown', which goes beyond PRD 4.8's list). Link targets and image sources are shown as plain text next to the link text or image placeholder.
The challenge node is identified by node_id 'challenge' together with kind 'review'. The independent review is the other review node.

In the candidate seed, the challenge node's status comes from an internal 'challenge' succeeded event. If the controller's server derives it from other evidence the snapshot status may differ; no test asserts that status.
The guarded run is synthetic: 'running', ui verified, the adapter's first verification blocked by the failure drill and its worker waiting on question 2.
